lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਛਉ ਪੂਛਉ ਦੀਨ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਕੋਊ ਕਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਦੇਸਾਂਗਿਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: poochhau poochhau deen bhaa(n)t kar kooo kahai pri desaa(n)gio ||
lines.translation: I ask and ask, with humility, "Who can tell me which country my Husband Lord lives in?"

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੀਂਓੁ ਦੇਂਉ ਸਭੁ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਉ ਸੀਸੁ ਚਰਣ ਪਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਓ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: hee(n)ou de(n)u sabh man tan arapau sees charan par raakhio ||2||
lines.translation: I would dedicate my heart to him, I offer my mind and body and everything; I place my head at his feet. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਬੰਦਨਾ ਅਮੋਲ ਦਾਸਰੋ ਦੇਂਉ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਅਰਦਾਗਿਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: charan ba(n)danaa amol daasaro de(n)u saadhasa(n)gat aradaagio ||
lines.translation: I bow at the feet of the voluntary slave of the Lord; I beg him to bless me with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਮਿਲਾਵਹੁ ਨਿਮਖ ਦਰਸੁ ਪੇਖਾਗਿਓ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: karahu kripaa mohi prabhoo milaavahu nimakh daras pekhaagio ||3||
lines.translation: Show Mercy to me, that I may meet God, and gaze upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan every moment. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਭਈ ਤਬ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਆਇਓ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸੀਤਲਾਗਿਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: drisat bhaee tab bheetar aaio meraa man anadin seetalaagio ||
lines.translation: When He is Kind to me, He comes to dwell within my being. Night and day, my mind is calm and peaceful.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਸਿ ਮੰਗਲ ਗਾਏ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਨਾਹਦੁ ਬਾਜਿਓ ॥੪॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak ras ma(n)gal gaae sabad anaahad baajio ||4||5||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, I sing the Songs of Joy; the Unstruck Word of the Shabad resounds within me. ||4||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਈ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਾਧਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaee sat sat sat har sat sat sat saadhaa ||
lines.translation: O mother, True, True True is the Lord, and True, True, True is His Holy Saint.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਚਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਜੋ ਪੂਰੈ ਕਹਿਓ ਮੈ ਛੀਕਿ ਗਾਂਠਰੀ ਬਾਧਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: bachan guroo jo poorai kahio mai chheek gaa(n)tharee baadhaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Word which the Perfect Guru has spoken, I have tied to my robe. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਸਿ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਨਖਿਅਤ੍ਰ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਰਵਿ ਸਸੀਅਰ ਬੇਨਾਧਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: nis baasur nakhiatr binaasee rav saseear benaadhaa ||
lines.translation: Night and day, and the stars in the sky shall vanish. The sun and the moon shall vanish.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਿਰਿ ਬਸੁਧਾ ਜਲ ਪਵਨ ਜਾਇਗੋ ਇਕਿ ਸਾਧ ਬਚਨ ਅਟਲਾਧਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gir basudhaa jal pavan jaaigo ik saadh bachan atalaadhaa ||1||
lines.translation: The mountains, the earth, the water and the air shall pass away. Only the Word of the Holy Saint shall endure. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਡ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਜੇਰ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਉਤਭੁਜ ਸੇਤ ਬਿਨਾਧਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)d binaasee jer binaasee utabhuj set binaadhaa ||
lines.translation: Those born of eggs shall pass away, and those born of the womb shall pass away. Those born of the earth and sweat shall pass away as well.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਖਟਹਿ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਇਕਿ ਸਾਧ ਬਚਨ ਨਿਹਚਲਾਧਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: chaar binaasee khatahi binaasee ik saadh bachan nihachalaadhaa ||2||
lines.translation: The four Vedas shall pass away, and the six Shaastras shall pass away. Only the Word of the Holy Saint is eternal. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਜ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਤਾਮ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਸਾਤਕੁ ਭੀ ਬੇਨਾਧਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: raaj binaasee taam binaasee saatak bhee benaadhaa ||
lines.translation: Raajas, the quality of energetic activity shall pass away. Taamas, the quality of lethargic darkness shall pass away. Saatvas, the quality of peaceful light shall pass away as well.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿਮਾਨ ਹੈ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਇਕਿ ਸਾਧ ਬਚਨ ਆਗਾਧਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: drisatimaan hai sagal binaasee ik saadh bachan aagaadhaa ||3||
lines.translation: All that is seen shall pass away. Only the Word of the Holy Saint is beyond destruction. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਆਪੇ ਸਭੁ ਆਪਨ ਖੇਲੁ ਦਿਖਾਧਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape aap aap hee aape sabh aapan khel dikhaadhaa ||
lines.translation: He Himself is Himself by Himself. All that is seen is His play.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਇਓ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਕਹੀ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਲਾਧਾ ॥੪॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: paaio na jaaee kahee bhaa(n)t re prabh naanak gur mil laadhaa ||4||6||
lines.translation: He cannot be found by any means. O Nanak, meeting with the Guru, God is found. ||4||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਬਾਸਿਬੋ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥
lines.transliteration: merai man baasibo gur gobi(n)d ||
lines.translation: The Guru, the Lord of the Universe, dwells within my mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਹਾਂ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਭਇਓ ਹੈ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਤਹਾਂ ਨਗਰ ਸੁਖ ਆਨੰਦ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jahaa(n) simaran bhaio hai thaakur tahaa(n) nagar sukh aana(n)d ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Wherever my Lord and Master is remembered in meditation - that village is filled with peace and bliss. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਹਾਂ ਬੀਸਰੈ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਪਿਆਰੋ ਤਹਾਂ ਦੂਖ ਸਭ ਆਪਦ ॥
lines.transliteration: jahaa(n) beesarai thaakur piaaro tahaa(n) dookh sabh aapad ||
lines.translation: Wherever my Beloved Lord and Master is forgotten - all misery and misfortune is there.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ਆਨੰਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਰੂਪ ਤਹਾਂ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਦ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jah gun gaai aana(n)d ma(n)gal roop tahaa(n) sadaa sukh sa(n)pad ||1||
lines.translation: Where the Praises of my Lord, the Embodiment of Bliss and Joy are sung - eternal peace and wealth are there. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਹਾ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਨ ਸੁਨੀਐ ਤਹ ਮਹਾ ਭਇਆਨ ਉਦਿਆਨਦ ॥
lines.transliteration: jahaa sravan har kathaa na suneeai tah mahaa bhaiaan udiaanad ||
lines.translation: Wherever they do not listen to the Stories of the Lord with their ears - the utterly desolate wilderness is there.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਹਾਂ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਰਸੁ ਤਹ ਸਘਨ ਬਾਸ ਫਲਾਂਨਦ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jahaa(n) keeratan saadhasa(n)gat ras tah saghan baas phalaa(n)nad ||2||
lines.translation: Where the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises are sung with love in the Saadh Sangat - there is fragrance and fruit and joy in abundance. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਕੋਟਿ ਬਰਖ ਜੀਵੈ ਸਗਲੀ ਅਉਧ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾਨਦ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin simaran kot barakh jeevai sagalee audh brithaanad ||
lines.translation: Without meditative remembrance on the Lord, one may live for millions of years, but his life would be totally useless.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਭਜਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਤਉ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਜੀਵਾਨਦ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: ek nimakh gobi(n)d bhajan kar tau sadaa sadaa jeevaanad ||3||
lines.translation: But if he vibrates and meditates on the Lord of the Universe, for even a moment, then he shall live forever and ever. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਨਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਵਉ ਦੀਜੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਿਰਪਾਨਦ ॥
lines.transliteration: saran saran saran prabh paavau deejai saadhasa(n)gat kirapaanad ||
lines.translation: O God, I seek Your Sanctuary, Your Sanctuary, Your Sanctuary; please mercifully bless me with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਹੈ ਸਰਬ ਮੈ ਸਗਲ ਗੁਣਾ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਂਨਦ ॥੪॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: naanak poor rahio hai sarab mai sagal gunaa bidh jaa(n)nad ||4||7||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Lord is All-pervading everywhere, amongst all. He knows the qualities and the condition of all. ||4||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਮੋਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਭਰੋਸਉ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: ab mohi raam bharosau paae ||
lines.translation: Now, I have obtained the Support of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਕਰੁਣਾਨਿਧਿ ਤੇ ਤੇ ਭਵਹਿ ਤਰਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo jo saran pario karunaanidh te te bhavahi taraae ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Those who seek the Sanctuary of the Ocean of Mercy are carried across the world-ocean. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖਿ ਸੋਇਓ ਅਰੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਓ ਸਹਸਾ ਗੁਰਹਿ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: sukh soio ar sahaj samaaio sahasaa gurahi gavaae ||
lines.translation: They sleep in peace, and intuitively merge into the Lord. The Guru takes away their cynicism and doubt.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਚਾਹਤ ਸੋਈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਓ ਮਨ ਬਾਂਛਤ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jo chaahat soee har keeo man baa(n)chhat phal paae ||1||
lines.translation: Whatever they wish for, the Lord does; they obtain the fruits of their minds' desires. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਜਪਉ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਲਾਵਉ ਸ੍ਰਵਨੀ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: hiradai japau netr dhiaan laavau sravanee kathaa sunaae ||
lines.translation: In my heart, I meditate on Him; with my eyes, I focus my meditation on Him. With my ears, I listen to His Sermon.
